content.text: {"Id":"BUG-TRIAGE-112","Title":"Session-log store: additive submit duplicates, missing tags, opaque EF errors","Section":"Backlog","Priority":"high","Done":false,"Estimate":null,"Note":null,"Description":["Fleet backfill (backfill-audit-20260722) hit six store/API defects in SessionLogService and related schema. Submit upserts turns by requestId with intentional additive MergeCollection (FR-SUPPORT-015), so resubmitted actions[] can grow duplicates when SameAction does not match; agents relied on replace_turn to converge. Session-root tags are not modeled: UnifiedSessionLogDto and SessionLogEntity have no Tags field (only SessionLogTurnTagEntity), so session-level tags in submit payloads are dropped and never reappear on query. ReplaceTurnAsync creates a turn when requestId is missing rather than returning not-found; DbUpdateException is not mapped on controller paths, so unique-index or concurrency failures surface as generic EF save errors (same pattern for large concurrent payloads and some status writes). RequestId uniqueness is only (SessionLogId, RequestId), so cross-session collisions are allowed; plugin double-fire can still leave duplicate turns when requestIds differ. Status canceled is recognized by IsTerminalTurnStatus but not documented in session-log-schema.md as a first-class value, and saves can still fail opaquely under EF/SQLite contention.","Triage group: triage-group-8bf8e3b03419a524","Reports: 1"],"TechnicalDetails":["Acceptance criteria:","- Resubmitting the same turn via sessionlog_submit with an identical full actions[] payload does not create duplicate action rows for that requestId; documented merge rules are explicit (additive by identity vs replace-on-full-payload).","- Tags supplied on a submit payload either persist at the documented scope (session and/or turn) and round-trip on sessionlog_query, or the API rejects unknown/unsupported tag scopes with a 400 (no silent drop).","- sessionlog_replace_turn for a missing session returns a structured not-found (or documented upsert) without a generic DbUpdateException; for a missing turn, behavior matches published API contract and never returns an untyped EF save error.","- Submit/replace of large valid payloads (tens of KB queryText/nested JSON) either succeeds or returns a stable, non-generic client error; transient SQLite/provider lock failures are retried or mapped to a retryable problem response.","- Duplicate turns within one session for the same requestId cannot be created by concurrent begin/submit races; cross-session requestId reuse is either documented as allowed or blocked by an explicit uniqueness policy with a clear error.","- Turn status values canceled and cancelled persist via submit/replace/complete paths, re-query with the same status, and are documented as valid terminal statuses alongside completed/failed.","Implementation notes:","- Primary code: src/McpServer.Services/Services/SessionLogService.cs (SubmitAsync, UpsertTurns with mergeOmittedFields:true, MergeCollection/SameAction, ReplaceTurnAsync upsert-on-missing, ValidateTerminalTurnCompliance/IsTerminalTurnStatus); entities SessionLogEntity (no Tags), SessionLogTurnEntity, SessionLogTurnTagEntity; unique index SessionLogId\u002BRequestId in McpDbContextModelSnapshot; SessionLogController ReplaceTurn maps only ArgumentException/InvalidOperationException, not DbUpdateException.","- Additive submit is currently intentional (FR-SUPPORT-015 comments). Fix options: tighten SameAction identity (stable action key), document that replace_turn/section is required for exact set semantics, or add an explicit replaceCollections flag on submit for full-turn repair without PUT.","- Session tags: add SessionLogTagEntity \u002B DTO property \u002B MapDtoToEntity/MapEntityToDto, or hard-fail on root-level tags and document turn-only tags in docs/context/session-log-schema.md.","- Error handling: catch DbUpdateException (unique, busy, constraint) and return ProblemDetails with stable codes; align ReplaceTurnAsync missing-turn policy with ReplaceTurnSectionAsync (return false/404) if upsert is undesired; consider soft-delete\u002Bunique index revive path like session resubmit.","- Concurrency: SubmitAsync only retries UNIQUE on session key; extend retry for SQLITE_BUSY/deadlock; serialise hot per-session writes if multi-writer fleets are in scope.","- Statuses: document canceled/cancelled; add unit/integration tests that set status canceled and re-query; do not rely on generic EF failures as validation.","- Plugin turn-begin double-fire is partly a client issue; server should remain idempotent on (session, requestId). Cross-session requestId examples are schema-legal today and need an explicit product decision."],"ImplementationTasks":null,"CompletedDate":null,"DoneSummary":null,"Remaining":null,"PriorityNote":null,"Reference":null,"Phase":null,"DependsOn":null,"FunctionalRequirements":["FR-MCP-TRIAGE-002"],"TechnicalRequirements":["TR-MCP-TRIAGE-004"],"IdempotencyKey":null}
